2609.04999.title: BIT.UA at BioASQ 14B: Modular Retrieval with pg_textsearch and Qdrant, and Agent-Based Answer Generation
2609.04999.paper_summary: This paper describes the participation of the BIT.UA team from the University of Aveiro in the 14th edition of the BioASQ Task B challenge on biomedical question answering. Building on our previous submissions, we introduced a substantially refactored and modular codebase, and made significant changes to both the retrieval and generation components of the pipeline. For Phase~A document retrieval, we replaced the PyTerrier PISA index with PostgreSQL-based pg\_textsearch for BM25 retrieval and adopted Qdrant for dense embedding indexing, enabling more efficient storage and GPU-accelerated similarity search. We explored HyDE-based query expansion alongside a Context-1 retrieval strategy. A new reranker training pipeline was developed, incorporating dense retrieval for negative sampling. For Phases A+ and B answer generation, we introduced an LLM-as-a-judge framework and a novel agent quorum mechanism, where multiple agents with diverse prompts debate and iteratively converge on a consensus answer using adaptive document retention. We also participated in the snippets generation subtask for the first time. Our systems achieved competitive results across all batches, with Phase~A systems achieving MAP ranks of 5 (Batch~1,3). We discuss the impact of these architectural changes, lessons learned, and outline directions for future work including SPLADE and ColBERT integration. All code is openly available: https://github.com/bioinformatics-ua/BioASQ14b.
2609.04999.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文描述了來自阿維羅大學的BIT.UA團隊參加第14屆BioASQ任務B挑戰的情況，該挑戰專注於生物醫學問題回答。基於我們之前的提交，我們引入了一個經過大幅重構和模組化的代碼庫，並對管道中的檢索和生成組件進行了重大更改。對於階段A的文檔檢索，我們用基於PostgreSQL的pg\_textsearch取代了PyTerrier PISA索引，以進行BM25檢索，並採用了Qdrant進行密集嵌入索引，從而實現了更高效的存儲和GPU加速的相似性搜索。我們探索了基於HyDE的查詢擴展，並結合了Context-1檢索策略。開發了一個新的重排序訓練管道，結合了密集檢索以進行負樣本抽樣。對於階段A+和B的答案生成，我們引入了一個LLM-as-a-judge框架和一種新穎的代理法定人機制，其中多個擁有不同提示的代理進行辯論，並通過自適應文檔保留逐步達成共識答案。我們還首次參加了片段生成子任務。我們的系統在所有批次中都取得了競爭性的結果，階段A系統在MAP排名中達到了5（批次1、3）。我們討論了這些架構變更的影響、所學到的教訓，並概述了未來工作的方向，包括SPLADE和ColBERT的整合。所有代碼均可公開獲取：https://github.com/bioinformatics-ua/BioASQ14b。
